event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: NED 223178 did not ask to withdraw the protest after the arbitration meeting and neither boat took a Post-Race Penalty under RRS T1(a).
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
NED 223178 was represented by Eefje Lemmers.
FRA 223249 was represented by Paloma Lopez De Silanes.
Keet Van Spijker (NED 221941) presented evidence during the hearing for NED 223178.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 6 to 7 knots of wind and waves 15 cm high.
Three boats entered the zone of the downwind starboard gate mark overlapped. NED 221941 was the inside boat, NED 223178 in the middle, and FRA 223249 was the outside boat.
NED 221941, clear ahead of NED 223178 by 30 cm, slowed while rounding the mark.
NED 223178 bore-off slightly before turning towards a close-hauled course.
At no time the distance between NED 223178 and the mark was more than 75cm.
FRA 223249 sailed into the gap between NED 223178 and the mark and made contact with NED 223178 amidships with her port side, and the mark with her starboard side.
conclusions: FRA 223249 outside overlapped at the zone failed to give NED 223178 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(1).
FRA 223249 did not avoid contact with NED 223178 even though it was reasonably possible and broke RRS 14(a).
FRA 223249 touched mark 4s and broke RRS 31.

It was not reasonably possible for NED 223178 the boat sailing within the mark-room to which she was entitled to avoid contact with FRA 223249 when it was clear that FRA 223249 was not giving mark-room. NED 223178 did not break RRS 14(a).
